title: Phlo Plugin Registry v2 (ADR 0053)
description: Strict v2 registry container. Entries carry static publisher descriptors only; the compatibility epoch counts the one-epoch legacy_verified compatibility window (ADR 0053 concern 5). legacy_verified is derived at migration and recorded only in the container-level legacy block, never on individual entries, so no registry author can assert it for a new entry.

compatibility_epoch.description: The current registry-contract compatibility epoch, counted by this schema version. legacy_verified is valid only in epoch 1 and is removed at the next epoch.

legacy_verified.description: Registry keys whose pre-migration v1 entry had verified: true. Derived by migration tooling and cross-checked against the v1 registry; carries no trust beyond community and expires with epoch 1.
